cases.statement: One male, Family F6 III-2 (PMID 33680117), diagnosed at 1 year without symptoms.

people.label: Family F6 III-2
people.key_phenotypes: diagnosed at 1 year with no clinical presentation; MLVWT 15 mm; LVEF 76%; E/e' 20.9; normal rhythm

Furthermore, two asymptomatic patients were coincidentally identified to have a frameshift mutation prior to their first birthday.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Cohort-level only. The person came from a series of 770 HCM patients screened with a 96-gene cardiac panel; each of the seven LAMP2 carriers had one LAMP2 variant reported. The paper does not state per person that other genes were negative.

quotes.quote: An exon and boarding intron analysis of 96 cardio disease-associated genes (Table SI) was performed in 770 patients with HCM using second-generation sequencing (11) at the HCM clinic in the Department of Ultrasound, Xijing Hospital (Xi'an, China) between May 2012 and February 2020.
Each of the seven patients was identified with one mutation in the LAMP2 gene (Table I and Fig. 2).
Patients with hypertension, coronary artery disease, aortic coarctation, congenital or valvular heart disease, metabolic disorder or athlete's heart were excluded.
All patients had an HCM phenotype on presentation with a mean MLVWT of 17 mm (range, 14-24 mm; Table I).

segregation.statement: Not reported for this person. The paper says the pedigree genotypes are in Figure 1 and gives only a summary across the seven families (four inherited from a parent, one de novo, two unconfirmed) without naming the families.

quotes.quote: The genotype for individuals is noted below the symbol, where available.

Regarding their occurrence in the pedigrees, four mutations were detected in one of their parents, one mutation was a de novo mutation and two mutations were not confirmed in their pedigree because their parents were not available.

de_novo.statement: Not reported for this person; the cohort-level summary does not say which family carried the de novo variant.

quotes.quote: Regarding their occurrence in the pedigrees, four mutations were detected in one of their parents, one mutation was a de novo mutation and two mutations were not confirmed in their pedigree because their parents were not available.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide deletion causing a frameshift (predicted p.(Val251LeufsTer32)). The paper states loss of function as the disease mechanism.

quotes.quote: It is caused by a loss-of-function mutation in the lysosome-associated membrane protein-2 (LAMP2) gene.
In total, three mutations were point mutations and four were frameshift mutations.

population_data_in_papers.statement: The methods say each variant was Sanger-sequenced in 300 healthy unrelated individuals; no per-variant result is given.

quotes.quote: The identified mutation was further confirmed by bidirectional Sanger sequencing among the remaining family members and 300 healthy unrelated individuals with normal ECG and echocardiographic findings and without any family history of cardiovascular disease.

authors_classification.statement: Cohort-level: the abstract calls the variant in each of the 7 patients disease-causing; the paper does not say whether this variant was among the five 'novel' ones.

quotes.quote: A pathogenic mutation in LAMP2 was identified in 7 patients who phenotypically presented with HCM.

Among the mutations, five were novel mutations, one mutation (c.928G>A) had previously been reported (17) and one mutation had been reported as a pathogenic mutation previously ClinVar (Aug 09, 2013; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/179062/) but had not been reported in individuals or large population studies.

concerns: The only description is one table column; there is no case narrative for F6 III-2.
Age: Table I gives 1 year at diagnosis, while the discussion says two asymptomatic frameshift carriers were found 'prior to their first birthday' (F5 was 6 months).

PMID 33680117 reports the family segregation only in Figure 1 (an image not in the text) and summarises it across the seven families without saying which family had which result, so parental status cannot be assigned to this person from the text.
PMID 33680117 says one of its seven variants had an earlier database entry and five were new, but does not say which variant is which apart from c.928G>A.
PMID 33680117 states 300 healthy controls were sequenced, but gives no per-variant result for them.
notes_for_panel: Very limited evidence: an asymptomatic infant from a single-centre HCM series, with LV wall thickness 15 mm.
